verse.verse_3: And Him Who hath created male and female,
verse.verse_4: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
verse.verse_5: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
verse.verse_7: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
verse.verse_8: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
verse.verse_10: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
verse.verse_11: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
verse.verse_12: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
verse.verse_13: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
verse.verse_14: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
verse.verse_15: Which only the most wretched must endure,
verse.verse_16: He who denieth and turneth away.
verse.verse_17: Far removed from it will be the righteous
verse.verse_18: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
verse.verse_19: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
verse.verse_20: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
